import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import tkinter as tk
from unittest.mock import patch
from app_health_checker.desktop import DesktopApp

root = tk.Tk()
root.title("Popup positioning test")
root.geometry("800x540")

def test():
    with patch.dict("os.environ", {}, clear=True):
        result = DesktopApp.credential_dialog(
            type("Demo", (), {"root": root})(),
            "DEMO", ("username", "password"))
    print(result == {"username": "demo", "password": "demo"})

tk.Button(root, text="Open demo popup", command=test).pack(pady=30)
root.mainloop()
